decisions.reason: The revised draft and revision turnaround times do not change the Canva source platform, editable access, or delivery artifact.
The schedule change does not alter the requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
Receiving final narrative content on a compressed schedule does not change the required integration or treatment of proposal tables.
The 48-hour draft turnaround changes delivery timing but not the single layout pass, final-draft input stage, or full-document coverage.
The source message separately changes branding, but the audited schedule modification itself does not affect the Agua Arc brand requirement.
The reference to final narrative content establishes the schedule trigger and does not change the requirement to integrate proposal content.
The revised turnaround schedule does not change the required photo integration or graphic treatment.
The source changes the turnaround time for final revisions but does not change the existing count of one consolidated revision round; timing remains owned by the delivery-schedule Requirement.
The compressed work schedule does not change the anticipated page count or page-limit constraint.
The source schedule applies to the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not modify the TPEC proposal-design requirement.
